results.title: India wins cricket's Women’s Asia Cup for the eighth time with 72-run win over Sri Lanka
results.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — India took control from the start to win the Women’s Asia Cup cricket tournament for an eighth time on Sunday, beating Sri Lanka by 72 runs in the final.
